elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The inserted INSURANCE paragraph covers only professional liability (E&O) and cyber/privacy liability; no commercial general liability coverage or per-occurrence limit appears anywhere in the rendered language.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: No CGL coverage and no aggregate limit is stated in the inserted clause or elsewhere in the Agreement.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted language sets E&O at "not less than USD 1,000,000", which is the fallback amount and below the preferred USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The condition applies (TrueLink hosts the web site and processes Client Content and Credit Data), but the inserted cyber and privacy limit is USD 2,000,000, not USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: No workers' compensation obligation appears in the inserted paragraph or elsewhere; the rationale expressly declines to volunteer it.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: No certificate-on-request mechanic is included in the inserted INSURANCE paragraph.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: "TrueLink shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000" — an affirmative, unconditional Vendor obligation at the required floor.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: "... and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000" — unconditional, not limited to selected named data categories, so it covers all Customer data exposure.

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: both elements are rendered as operative, unconditional obligations of TrueLink at exactly the fallback limits (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber and privacy USD 2,000,000), with no undefined trigger and no internal inconsistency.

Preferred level is incomplete: CGL per-occurrence and aggregate limits, E&O at USD 2,000,000, cyber at USD 5,000,000, workers' compensation, and certificates on request are all absent. This is disclosed in the rationale rather than promised in operative language, which is the correct treatment for a fallback-level proposal.

Minimality holds: the insertion adds only the two required coverages and omits model-language extras that no selected element requires (at-its-own-expense, term-plus-one-year survival tail, CGL, workers' compensation, certificates). No existing text was deleted or paraphrased — Section 30 (Force Majeure) is retained verbatim.

Intent preserved: the clause is placed after Section 30 and before signatures, leaves no undefined term or dangling cross-reference, and does not contradict the indemnity at Section 12 or the miscellaneous provisions; insurance and indemnity remain independent allocations.

Drafting nit only (not a defect requiring repair for completeness): the inserted heading "INSURANCE." carries no section number, so it should be numbered (e.g., "31. INSURANCE.") to match the Agreement's numbering convention.
If TrueLink pushes back, note that the position sits at the fallback and the preferred schedule (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, workers' comp, certificates on request) remains available.
